issues.where: the tall strider in the left-midground, the herd across the middle plain, and the smaller creature in the foreground
issues.what: every animal stays completely motionless in the exact same pose and position across all 6 seconds, reading as static 3D models rather than living creatures
issues.fix: animate individual weight shifts, asynchronous steps, pauses, and subtle body or head turns across the herd so no animal stands frozen like a statue

issues.where: the lava cascade pouring from the cave mouth and the glowing crusted lava lake across the caldera floor
issues.what: over 6 full seconds the bright lava knots, flow bands, and glowing crust fissures stay locked in place with no visible downward flow, folding skin, or heaving surface
issues.fix: drive continuous slow viscous advection and crust-folding down the cascade and across the lake surface so the molten rock visibly flows and shifts under its own weight

issues.where: the steam vent on the left rocky ridge and the large grey smoke plumes above the far caldera rim
issues.what: across 6 seconds the vapour and smoke plumes barely drift or rise, changing only slightly in place like a faint pulsing texture rather than rising volcanic plumes and pooling vapour
issues.fix: give the background plumes clear upward buoyancy and wind drift at height, and make the foreground ridge steam billow and disperse continuously

issues.where: the cave arch, cliff walls, and low atmospheric haze
issues.what: the orange bounce light from the lava and flames remains completely flat and constant over 6 seconds, reinforcing the impression of a still picture
issues.fix: couple subtle organic light variation on the cave roof, nearby rock, and low haze to the moving lava flow and flickering fires
